Use case: identity-preserve, the one targeted final revision of Ena's portrait.
Image 1 is the existing ENA portrait to revise. Image 2 is Mara only as a guide for TIGHT face framing and restrained eye size; never copy Mara's face, red scarf or hair.
Keep ENA (NPC-N-ENA), a quietly tough working-class wife in her mid-thirties: the same brown hair, aged cream headscarf with side knot, plain brown old shawl/outerwear, warm weathered skin. No new wrinkles or old-age features. No widow/mourning outcome, tears or compensation symbols.
Revise these aspects together:
1. Recompose to a very tight face portrait: almost no visible neck, NO shoulder/chest area. Enlarge the facial area vertically and horizontally; crown just one or two logical pixels below canvas top, chin near bottom, only a narrow brown shawl/collar sliver at bottom edge. Keep complete crown/headscarf knot and whole jaw. The scarf must not consume the top third: compact it around the skull into just 3 or 4 large connected cloth planes, one simple knot, no many narrow fold stripes.
2. Distinct ENA face: slightly widen the mature face and soften the overly long/pointed lower contour into a practical sturdy lower jaw; give the nose blunt, somewhat broader readable nostril wings. Keep tired cheek/under-eye planes without extra fine wrinkles. Reduce the extreme raised crying brows: brows closer to level with a SMALL worried inward pinch. Closed mouth straighter and resolute. Concern plus practical resilience, not tears, sad doll or crying victim.
3. Greatly reduce the oversized eye-white shapes. Eyes should be small horizontal mature eyes, upper lids lower by about one logical pixel, dark-brown iris with a tiny low-contrast grayish-warm-beige sclera sliver, NO bright white block, catchlight or black-hole eye. Preserve sideward alert look. Hair: merge to a few broad clumps, no narrow diagonal stripes or dangling fine strands.
Logical 74x100 coarse hard-edged pixel style, large flat connected skin planes and square stairs, deep brown outline, fewer than 32 colors, true transparent background. No antialiasing, dithering, texture noise, long fine hair, smooth gradients, extra props, frame or text. Redraw geometry through image generation, not a crop of the old image.
